retrieved_chunks.title: Payments and cash on delivery
retrieved_chunks.heading: Cash on delivery
retrieved_chunks.text: COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order.

retrieved_chunks.title: Payments and cash on delivery
retrieved_chunks.heading: Payment methods
retrieved_chunks.text: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, ZentroMart Wallet and cash on delivery (COD).

retrieved_chunks.title: Refunds policy
retrieved_chunks.heading: Delivery and COD fees
retrieved_chunks.text: Delivery fees and the ₹25 cash-on-delivery fee are refunded only when the whole order is cancelled before shipping or returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

retrieved_chunks.title: Refunds policy
retrieved_chunks.heading: Cash-on-delivery refunds
retrieved_chunks.text: For cash-on-delivery orders, the customer chooses either ZentroMart Wallet (instant) or a bank transfer. Bank transfers start only after the bank account details are verified, then take 5 to 7 business days.

retrieved_chunks.title: Delivery and shipping policy
retrieved_chunks.heading: Where we deliver
retrieved_chunks.text: ZentroMart delivers only within India, to pincodes listed as serviceable in the pincode table. Cash on delivery and Express are available only where the pincode table says so (`cod_available`, `express_available`). Not every metro pincode has Express.

retrieved_chunks.title: Delivery and shipping policy
retrieved_chunks.heading: Delivery fees
retrieved_chunks.text: Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

retrieved_chunks.title: About this knowledge base
retrieved_chunks.heading: Which document wins
retrieved_chunks.text:
When two documents disagree, follow this order of precedence:

1. **Policy documents** (doc_type: policy) with status `current`.
2. **Agent guides** (doc_type: agent_guide).
3. **Help articles** (doc_type: help).
4. **FAQs** (doc_type: faq).
5. **Marketing pages** (doc_type: marketing). These describe benefits in general terms and never override a policy.


Documents marked `status: superseded` are kept for reference only. They apply only to the cases their successor document says they still cover.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conversation style
retrieved_chunks.heading: Opening
retrieved_chunks.text: Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conversation style
retrieved_chunks.heading: Written replies
retrieved_chunks.text: Keep chat replies to two or three short sentences. In emails and tickets, start with a greeting, answer the question first, and end with a sign-off. Write dates with the month name ("24 October").

retrieved_chunks.title: Conversation style
retrieved_chunks.heading: Voice replies
retrieved_chunks.text: When replying by voice, keep it to two or three short sentences. Say dates with the month name ("the 24th of October"), read order IDs in groups of four digits, and say amounts in rupees ("forty-nine rupees").

retrieved_chunks.title: Conversation style
retrieved_chunks.heading: Language
retrieved_chunks.text: Reply in the language the customer uses. If the customer switches language, switch with them.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conversation style
retrieved_chunks.heading: One question at a time
retrieved_chunks.text: When you need details, ask for one thing at a time.

retrieved_chunks.title: Escalation and human handover
retrieved_chunks.heading: When to hand over to a human
retrieved_chunks.text:
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

retrieved_chunks.title: Escalation and human handover
retrieved_chunks.heading: What to do first
retrieved_chunks.text: Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states.

retrieved_chunks.title: Escalation and human handover
retrieved_chunks.heading: Handover summary
retrieved_chunks.text: The ticket summary must contain: the customer's issue, the detected intent, the order ID if any, what the customer has already told you, what you already checked, and the reason for escalation.

retrieved_chunks.title: Escalation and human handover
retrieved_chunks.heading: Things you must never do
retrieved_chunks.text:
- Promise compensation, refunds or exceptions that a policy does not allow.
- Say an action is done unless the tool call succeeded.
- Share another customer's details.

retrieved_chunks.title: Verifying the customer
retrieved_chunks.heading: When verification is needed
retrieved_chunks.text: Before sharing anything about a specific order (status, items, address, amounts, refund details), verify the customer. General policy questions need no verification.

retrieved_chunks.title: Verifying the customer
retrieved_chunks.heading: How to verify
retrieved_chunks.text: Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

retrieved_chunks.title: Verifying the customer
retrieved_chunks.heading: If verification fails
retrieved_chunks.text: Allow one retry. If it fails again, do not share order details. Offer general policy help and suggest the customer contact support from the registered phone number.

retrieved_chunks.title: Verifying the customer
retrieved_chunks.heading: Never read out
retrieved_chunks.text: Never read out the full phone number, email or street address, even to a verified customer.
